complete.plugin.sub_quarantine: unsigned plugins still inside their waiting period
help.command.plugin_quarantine: unsigned plugins still inside their waiting period, and how to admit one
plugincli.keygen.next:
register the public key on every machine that installs your plugins:
  chatcli plugin trust --key %s
plugincli.keygen.output_required: --output is required: name the directory to write the key pair into
plugincli.quarantine.disabled: quarantine is off. Set CHATCLI_PLUGIN_QUARANTINE to a duration (for example 24h) to hold newly seen unsigned plugins before they can run.
plugincli.quarantine.empty: quarantine is on with a %s window; no plugin is waiting
plugincli.quarantine.release_name_requir: name the plugin to release: chatcli plugin quarantine release <name>
plugincli.quarantine.released: %s released; it loads on the next reload. Replacing the binary puts it back in quarantine.
plugincli.quarantine.unknown_verb: unknown quarantine subcommand %q; use list or release
plugincli.sign.binary_required: --binary is required: name the plugin binary to sign
plugincli.sign.key_required: --key is required: name the private key from 'chatcli plugin keygen'
plugincli.trust.key_required: --key is required: name the public key to trust
plugincli.verify.binary_required: --binary is required: name the plugin binary to verify
plugincli.verify.no_signature: %s has no signature file beside it; sign it with 'chatcli plugin sign'
plugincli.verify.no_trusted_keys: no trusted public keys are registered; add one with 'chatcli plugin trust --key <path>'
